title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories

info.about: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories is a 2005 action-adventure game developed in a collaboration between Rockstar Leeds and Rockstar North, and published by Rockstar Games. The ninth installment in the Grand Theft Auto series, it was initially released as a PlayStation Portable exclusive in October 2005.
info.trivia: The PSP's biggest seller in its first year.
info.why: The best-selling PSP game of its first year, later ported to PS2 and phones, so copies are everywhere and prices stay low.
